Additionally, there are three emails addressed to 'Casey' regarding business collaborations: Sophia Martinez from Fashion Forward inquired about an influencer campaign partnership (content:08), Derek Scott from Eco-Friendly Packaging Solutions requested a rebranding proposal (content:09), and Rachel Kim from Digital AdWorks requested an AdWords campaign performance analysis (content:10)."
